_help: Phone alerts (engine/notify.py, docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md). true = on, false = off. Times are New York (ET). In quiet hours ordinary alerts arrive WITHOUT sound (summaries and milestones wait for the end); the kinds in ring_in_quiet_hours still ring. Owner 2026-11-18 "important only" + every entry the moment it happens (trade_opened, owner 2026-11-18 evening: "notifications when we get in a trade in any account"): trade results, pass / fail / locked / payout ready (account_status), PC silent, the daily summary, the 07:30 ET morning brief (morning_brief, morning_brief_at). Problems (bot down / FEED STALE / NinjaTrader closed) stay ON as emergencies (lead 2026-11-18). Set a type to true to get it back (problems = bot down / FEED STALE / NinjaTrader closed).
